description: Use this when someone wants the full plan for one public itinerary, by its slug: day-by-day or themed stops with real venues and map links, rainy-day and where-to-eat sections, and the best season. Returns dayCount and stopCount (anchors plus backups; before 2026-09-28 stopCount held the day count), the page URL, and planUrl, which opens the WonderKit planner prefilled from this plan. Read-only; it cannot change a plan.

city.description: City name or WonderKit city key, such as "Paris" or "paris-france".

slug.description: Itinerary slug from list_itineraries or search_itineraries, such as "3-day-weekend-for-couples".

name: get_itinerary

mapUrl.description: Google Maps search for the venue
Google Maps search for the venue

found.description: false when the lookup did not resolve

matches.description: Candidate cities when the name is ambiguous

nearest.description: Covered cities in or near the asked-for area. Not the city that was asked for

url.description: The WonderKit page for this city

why.description: Why this city is offered, e.g. "in Vermont" or "near Wyoming"

planDescription.description: One line saying what planUrl opens

planUrl.description: Give this to the person to plan this trip: the WonderKit planner prefilled from this itinerary

reason.description: unknown_city, region_not_city, no_city_guide, no_itineraries_for_city, ambiguous_city, no_published_guide, no_matches, unknown_itinerary, lookup_failed, …

region.description: The state, country, or area the city ask was read as

peakMonths.description: 1-12, when the page has a real peak

window.description: Human-readable best window, e.g. "Peak colour late Sep – mid Oct"

sections.description: Rainy-day backups, where to eat, and similar

stopCount.description: Named stops (anchors plus backups), not days; see dayCount. Until 2026-09-28 this carried the day count

suggestions.description: Near-miss spellings, or same-name cities elsewhere, when the name is unknown

title: Get itinerary
